coverage.target: No infrastructure is required for the offline path: the runtime exists once the project is installed, with no host, container or service (infrastructure-specification.md)
No infrastructure element reaches the network; the only outbound path is the live call the user initiates (infrastructure-specification.md, monitoring-design.md)

Design-level: redaction is a code concern carried by the NFR design's Settings resolver and Session credential holder; no infrastructure element holds a credential (infrastructure-specification.md, 'No secrets infrastructure')
No vault, no injected environment variable and no CI secret; the credential lives in a local ignored file or in memory (infrastructure-specification.md)
The install step installs two runtime packages onto the user's machine; no container image or provisioning layer is introduced (infrastructure-specification.md)
The development extra, including the coverage and lint tooling, is installed only for development (infrastructure-specification.md, cicd-pipeline.md)
The coverage floor runs through the checkpoint verification command; the missing pipeline is recorded as a stated gap with the minimal job that would close it (cicd-pipeline.md, monitoring-design.md)
The suite result and the coverage report are the visible signal a change gets, since no pipeline exists (monitoring-design.md)
One loopback port, bound by the application at start; nothing exposes it beyond the machine (infrastructure-specification.md)
No container, no host, no orchestrator and no environment tiers; the deployment target is the machine the app runs on (infrastructure-specification.md)
The health endpoint and the page indicator are the monitoring surface; there is no metrics service or aggregator (monitoring-design.md)
Startup mode and the missing-key warning are the process's own log output, read on the machine that produced it (monitoring-design.md)
No log aggregator or error tracker receives anything, so credential material has no off-machine destination (monitoring-design.md, 'There is no telemetry')
